title: The Ninth Thing She Cooked
subtitle: 饮食与胃口 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与胃口（生活与自我·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与胃口（生活与自我·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：appetite　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 appetite 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my brother lost ① his appetite for nine weeks and my grandmother cooked nine things a day until it came back. There was ② appetite in the house again by April, and she said appetite is the only illness you can cure with a smell; an appetite, she said, is a door that opens from the outside. She said she had never once managed to open it by knocking.

The ③ appetite he had in September was not hunger, my grandmother said, because hunger is a fact and an appetite is an opinion. Every ④ appetite, she told the doctor, arrives at a time of day and leaves at a time of day; an appetite, the doctor said, is the only thing in a body that has a schedule and no clock. He wrote the hour down too, and she said two people writing the same hour down is a kind of company.

My father had ⑤ an appetite for the sea, which is different, and it took him to nine ports and brought him back to the same kitchen. The ⑥ appetite, meaning the wanting and not the eating, is nine-tenths of the meal, my grandmother said; an appetite, she said, is the part of dinner you cannot buy.

By 1971 she judged every visitor by ⑦ their appetite, and a man who left rice was a man she did not ask again. The ⑧ appetite of a growing boy, she said, is the only thing in a house that costs money twice; an appetite, my father said, is a bill that arrives before the food. My grandmother said he had got that out of a book.

The  appetite I remember is my brother's, coming back on the ninth of April, with the ninth thing she had cooked that day. An  appetite, she said in 1979, is the only thing a person has that can be lost without being missed until it is gone; and she said that was true of more than food.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 胃口；食欲（某人的、具体的）
B. n. 食欲（泛指这种想吃的状态）
C. n. （某一时刻的）胃口、食欲
D. 固定搭配：an appetite for something 对……的强烈欲望
E. n. 食欲（指“想要”本身，与进食相对）
F. n. 胃口；食量（一个人的）
G. n. 食欲（抽象总称；泛指这种东西）
H. n. 胃口（长身体的孩子的）

items.q: The appetite he had in September
Every appetite, she told the doctor
The appetite of a growing boy

answers.why: appetite 意为“胃口、食欲”，1962 年弟弟有九个星期没有胃口，祖母一天做九样东西直到它回来。
appetite 泛指“食欲、想吃的状态”，到四月屋里又有了食欲，她说这是唯一能用气味治好的病。
appetite 指“某一时刻的胃口”，他九月里那种胃口不是饿，因为饿是事实，胃口是看法。
appetite 为抽象总称，她说每一种食欲都是在一天里的某个时刻来、某个时刻走。
an appetite for something 意为“对……的强烈欲望”，父亲对大海有一种强烈的向往，那是不一样的。
appetite 指“想要”本身，与进食相对，祖母说想吃的念头占了一顿饭的九成。
appetite 意为“胃口、食量”，到 1971 年她凭客人的食量评判人，剩下米饭的人她不再请第二次。
appetite 指长身体的孩子的胃口，她说那是屋里唯一要花两次钱的东西。
